tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Everything that is powered by the Xentral Analytics Platform.

tags.name: App
tags.description: App represents information about apps available in the appstore.

tags.name: AuthPlatform
tags.description: AuthPlatform represents the oauth login for Xentral

tags.description: Create and manage collections for your reports.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: Contacts represents the individual or company information.

tags.name: Credit
tags.description: Get information about your current current and monthly credits regarding Report usage.

tags.name: Credit Note
tags.description: A credit note is a document you send to your customer to correct a mistake on an order or an invoice, or to refund an amount paid for products or services.

tags.name: Customer
tags.description: Customer represents an information related to company, or individual person.

tags.name: Customer Address
tags.description: Represents the address associated with a specific customer, including details such as location, contact information, and address type.

tags.name: Customer - Contact Person
tags.description: Contact person information related to a specific customer

tags.name: Documentation
tags.description: Get documentation about our data catalog, tables and columns.

tags.name: Email Account
tags.description: Email accounts that are available for sending/receiving emails in Xentral.

tags.name: Exchange Rates
tags.description: Exchange rates provided by EXR Service.

tags.name: External Reference
tags.description: External shop references that are linked to a product.

tags.name: External Reference Target
tags.description: All external shops that exists within Xentral

tags.name: File
tags.description: Get a business document file and its metadata.

tags.name: Goods Receipt
tags.description: Goods Receipt for physical incoming goods.

tags.name: Invoice
tags.description: An invoice is a commercial document issued by a seller to a buyer relating to a sale transaction and indicating the products, quantities, and agreed-upon prices for products or services the seller had provided the buyer.

tags.name: Liability
tags.description: Returns a collection with all liabilities.

tags.name: Payment Terms Group
tags.description: PaymentTermsGroups can be used to group customers with identical payment terms such as different discounts, payment targets, and free postage options.

tags.name: Password Reset
tags.description: Password Reset represents an one-time access key to change the password of the connected User.

tags.name: Personal Access Token
tags.description: Personal access token which are used to authenticate against API v3.

tags.name: Pick List
tags.description: A picking list contains instructions how to retrieve stock for fulfilling a single or a set of orders

tags.name: Printer
tags.description: An entity represent the physical printer connected to the instance.

tags.name: Print Jobs
tags.description: Print Jobs represent the jobs that are sent to the printer.

tags.name: Printer Setup
tags.description: A printer setup for the wizard.

tags.name: Product
tags.description: Product represents the services or things given company sells in the business.

tags.name: Product Category
tags.description: Product Category represents the Product Category Tree that can be used to categorise products.

tags.name: Product Free Field
tags.description: 40 product free fields can be used and individually labeled.

tags.name: Product Import
tags.description: Management of various ways of importing products into the system.

tags.name: Product Property
tags.description: Product properties describe its physical traits.

tags.name: Purchase Order
tags.description: Purchase Orders made at a supplier.

tags.name: Purchase Price
tags.description: PurchasePrices determine the prices used for the purchasing of products.

tags.name: Query
tags.description: Create, manage and export reports and report results based on SQL queries against your data.

tags.name: Report
tags.description: Create, manage and export reports and report results based on SQL queries against your data.

tags.name: Report Usage
tags.description: Provide information about your usage in terms of credits spent.

tags.name: Return
tags.description: Return represents incoming shipments from customer to supplier

tags.name: Return Reason
tags.description: Return reason describes why an item is being returned

tags.name: Ruleset
tags.description: Provide information about the accessible Analytics Platform features based on the package the license is on.

tags.name: Sales Channels Product Settings
tags.description: Sales Channel Settings inside a product.

tags.name: Sales Price
tags.description: SalesPrices determine the prices used in sales to customers.

tags.name: Sales Order
tags.description: SalesOrders are an outbound orders, meaning that someone has bought from you.

tags.name: Supplier
tags.description: Suppliers represents an information related to providers of goods the company is managing.

tags.name: Token
tags.description: Valid tokens grant access to API endpoints. You can exchange credentials in POST endpoint to create one.

tags.name: UI Analytics
tags.description: Information about instance statistics and insights.

tags.name: UI Bookmark
tags.description: Bookmarks allow saving external resources for a quick access.

tags.name: UI Calendar
tags.description: Calendar hosts resources related to the events scheduled in the company.

tags.name: UI Query
tags.description: Collection of endpoints which return data for BI features in the front end.

tags.name: UI Search
tags.description: Search allows to look for information matching given query and interact with it.

tags.name: UI SystemMessage
tags.description: SystemMessage is an automated status check verifying correct behavior of one of the many modules.

tags.name: User
tags.description: User represents a Xentral account used to access other parts of the system.

tags.name: Storage Location
tags.description: Represents the spaces within a warehouse

tags.name: Storage Item
tags.description: Represent a storage item in a storage location

tags.name: Warehouse
tags.description: Represents a location with storage space

tags.name: Tax Rate
tags.description: Represents a tax rate for a product on given day and for given country

tags.name: UI Polling
tags.description: Polling is used to check the connection to the Xentral backend.

CAUTION: Positions not specified in the payload will be DELETED. Please pass the ids along if you need them to be preserved.

get.description:
This endpoint returns the tax rate for a given country code. The country code is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. The response is a list of applicable tax rates for the given country code.
To get a more granular response you can use the query parameters to filter the response, for example by product or project.

The applicable tax rate is determined in the following order:
1. If a custom tax rate is defined for the product, it is returned.
2. If a tax rate is defined in the taxRates module for that country, it is returned.
3. If a tax rate is defined in the taxRates module for the project, or a generic tax Rate without country or project it is returned.
4. If a tax rate is defined for the applicable project it is returned.
5. If a tax rate is defined for the system it is returned.
6. If no tax rate is defined anywhere we will return an empty list.

To see which step was used to determine the tax rate, the source field is returned in the response.
